{{Short description|Estonian mathematician and biologist (1939–2019)}}
'''Tõnu Möls''' (12 June 1939 in [[Tartu]] – 1 December 2019<ref name="death">{{cite web |title=In memoriam: Tõnu Möls |url=https://pk.emu.ee/yldinfo/uudised/uudis/2019/12/07/in-memoriam-tonu-mols |website=pk.emu.ee |access-date=9 April 2021}}</ref> ) was an [[Estonia]]n mathematician and biologist.<ref name="ETIS">{{cite web |title=CV: Tõnu Möls |url=https://www.etis.ee/CV/T%C3%B5nu_M%C3%B6ls/est |website=www.etis.ee |access-date=8 April 2021}}</ref>

In 1965 he described the moth ''[[Epirrhoe tartuensis]]''.<ref>Juhani Püttsepp. 1994. Matemaatika ilu ja bioloogide probleemid. [[Eesti Loodus]] 1: 1–3. [Interview with Tõnu Möls]</ref>

From 1994 until 2004, he was the president of [[Estonian Naturalists' Society]].<ref name="ETIS" />

In 2001, he was awarded with [[Order of the White Star]], V class.<ref name="president.ee">{{cite web |title=Teenetemärkide kavalerid: Tõnu Mols |url=https://www.president.ee/et/vabariik/teenetemargid/kavaler/3665/tonu-mols |website=www.president.ee |access-date=6 April 2021}}</ref>
